entry.name: PLANE_MODE_HDGALT
entry.description: HDGALT

enum.name: HDGALT_COMMAND_FLAGS
enum.description: Bitmask of which axes a HDGALT_COMMAND sets. A clear bit means the autopilot keeps its current value for that axis.

entry.name: HDGALT_COMMAND_FLAG_HEADING
entry.description: Set if heading_deg is valid.

entry.name: HDGALT_COMMAND_FLAG_TURN_RATE
entry.description: Set if turn_rate_dps is valid.

entry.name: HDGALT_COMMAND_FLAG_ALTITUDE
entry.description: Set if altitude_m is valid.

entry.name: HDGALT_COMMAND_FLAG_CLIMB_RATE
entry.description: Set if climb_rate_mps is valid.

enum.name: HDGALT_STATE_FLAGS
enum.description: Bitmask of which axes the HDGALT mode is actively controlling.

entry.name: HDGALT_STATE_FLAG_HEADING_ACTIVE
entry.description: Set if heading is being actively controlled.

entry.name: HDGALT_STATE_FLAG_ALTITUDE_ACTIVE
entry.description: Set if altitude is being actively controlled.

enum.name: HDGALT_CAPTURE_STATE
enum.description: Capture/hold phase reported by the HDGALT mode.

entry.name: HDGALT_CAPTURE_HOLD
entry.description: Both axes within deadband; holding.

entry.name: HDGALT_CAPTURE_LATERAL
entry.description: Capturing heading; altitude held.

entry.name: HDGALT_CAPTURE_VERTICAL
entry.description: Capturing altitude; heading held.

entry.name: HDGALT_CAPTURE_BOTH
entry.description: Capturing both heading and altitude.

entry.name: HDGALT_WARNING_CLIMB_UNACHIEVABLE
entry.description: Commanded altitude could not be reached; altitude target clipped to current, holding.

entry.name: HDGALT_WARNING_TURN_DERATED
entry.description: Commanded turn rate clipped by bank or stall-margin limit.

entry.name: HDGALT_WARNING_AIRSPEED_LOW
entry.description: Airspeed approaching the minimum at which HDGALT disengages.

enum.name: VNAV_OBS_KIND
enum.description: Source kind of a VNAV_OBSERVATION; selects the interpretation of the bearing/range fields. The navigator's estimator never sees the kind beyond normalization.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_KIND_VISUAL
entry.description: Visual landmark recognizer: bearing (relative or true per flags) and optional ground range.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_KIND_VOR
entry.description: VOR receiver: bearing_deg is the radial (bearing FROM the station, in the station's calibration frame); use decl_cdeg.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_KIND_NDB
entry.description: ADF/NDB: bearing_deg is relative to the aircraft nose.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_KIND_DME
entry.description: DME: range_m is SLANT range; no bearing.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_FLAG_BEARING
entry.description: bearing_deg (and bearing_sigma_deg) are valid.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_FLAG_BEARING_RELATIVE
entry.description: bearing_deg is body-frame relative to the aircraft nose, positive right; clear means true bearing aircraft to reference (visual) or kind-specific absolute (VOR radial).

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_FLAG_RANGE
entry.description: range_m (and range_frac_sigma) are valid.

entry.name: VNAV_OBS_FLAG_DECL
entry.description: decl_cdeg is valid (VOR station declination of record).

entry.name: VNAV_POSE_OK
entry.description: Pose fields are valid.

entry.name: VNAV_POSE_UNANCHORED
entry.description: The navigator's estimator has not initialized yet; retry later.

entry.name: VNAV_POSE_NO_ATTITUDE
entry.description: No attitude telemetry seen yet; retry later.

message.name: HDGALT_COMMAND
message.description: Flight director command to the ArduPlane HDGALT mode: set commanded magnetic heading and/or barometric altitude with optional rate caps. Per-axis flags select which fields are applied; unset axes keep their current value.
message.field: AP-local time (same base as SYSTEM_TIME.time_boot_ms) at which to begin executing. 0 = execute on receipt. A future value queues the command (single slot, replaces any pending one). A past nonzero value executes immediately and is logged as late.
Bitmask selecting which axes this command sets.
Commanded magnetic heading, 0-360.
Commanded turn rate magnitude during heading capture; AP picks the shortest direction.
Commanded barometric altitude (MSL).
Commanded climb-rate cap magnitude during altitude capture; sign derived from the altitude delta.

message.name: HDGALT_STATE
message.description: Periodic state report from the ArduPlane HDGALT mode (1 Hz minimum while engaged), letting the flight director observe commanded versus achieved heading and altitude, capture phase, and warnings.
message.field: AP timestamp (time since system boot).
Bitmask of which axes are actively controlled.
Start time of the queued future command, or 0 if none queued.
Current commanded heading.
Measured magnetic heading.
Turn rate the FD asked for, or the parameter default.
Turn rate the AP is actually achieving.
Current commanded altitude.
Measured barometric altitude.
Commanded climb-rate cap.
Actual vertical speed.
Current airspeed, for FD situational awareness.
Capture/hold phase.
Warning bits.

message.name: VNAV_OBSERVATION
message.description: A ranked-candidate reference-point observation for the navigator (visual landmark recognizer, VOR, NDB or DME). Candidates are the genuinely confusable set, pre-thinned by the observer; scores are relative weights, monotonic in confidence (calibration not required, honesty about uncertainty is), renormalized with null_score to sum 1 by the consumer. The null row is the first-class "this sighting corroborates nothing" outcome and is actively consumed; do not suppress it.
message.field: Capture time of the underlying image/signal (same base as SYSTEM_TIME.time_boot_ms). Processing lag up to the navigator's window (default 6 min) is compensated; 0 means unknown and is treated as arrival time.
Observation source kind.
Field-validity bits.
Bearing per kind and flags: relative to the nose (positive right) or true aircraft-to-reference; for VOR the radial.
1-sigma bearing error; 0 = consumer default.
Range: horizontal ground range (visual), slant range (DME); see kind.
Fractional 1-sigma range error; 0 = consumer default.
VOR station declination of record, centidegrees east-positive (the magnetic alignment the station was calibrated to, not the current field).
Null-row weight, 0..255 scale.
Number of valid entries in the candidate arrays, 1..5.
Candidate latitudes (WGS84), degrees * 1e7.
Candidate longitudes (WGS84), degrees * 1e7.
Candidate weights, 0..255 scale, ranked descending.
Candidate elevations AMSL (from the observer's database); 0 if unknown.

message.name: VNAV_POSE_REQUEST
message.description: Ask the navigator for its believed aircraft pose at a capture time, to seed a landmark search (an ever-growing circle around the answer). The navigator replies with VNAV_POSE on the same link.
message.field: Capture time being asked about (same base as SYSTEM_TIME.time_boot_ms).

message.name: VNAV_POSE
message.description: The navigator's believed aircraft pose at the requested capture time, retrodicted consistently with how a delayed observation at that time will be fused. On a non-OK result only time_boot_ms and result are meaningful; back off and retry.
message.field: Echo of the request's capture time.
Validity of the pose fields.
Believed latitude at capture time (WGS84), degrees * 1e7.
Believed longitude at capture time (WGS84), degrees * 1e7.
1-sigma-ish horizontal uncertainty: a sensible initial search radius, not a bound.
Barometric altitude AMSL, bias-corrected; soft (can carry a QNH-class offset).
Roll at capture time, centidegrees, right positive.
Pitch at capture time, centidegrees, up positive.
TRUE heading at capture time, centidegrees, 0..35999.
Live hypothesis count; above 1 the navigator entertains multiple position stories and the search should widen.
Lost-track indicator, 0..255 scale; high means recent sightings corroborated nothing - widen everything.
